mcp-policy-scope.title: Can an MCP server run at all?
mcp-policy-scope.description: Check whether the seat is governed and whether the MCP servers in Copilot policy is enabled, then use allowlists, denylists or a registry to decide which servers run.

server-inventory.title: Where MCP servers are configured
server-inventory.description: Four configuration locations with their editors and whether managed-settings allow and deny lists apply; repository custom agent profiles are not covered.

allowlist-evaluation.title: How a client evaluates an MCP server
allowlist-evaluation.description: Built-in defaults are allowed first, any deny match blocks, an allowlist without a match blocks, and an unresolved variable blocks; otherwise the server runs.

registry-tradeoffs.title: Allowlist or registry
registry-tradeoffs.description: Compare managed-settings allowlists with public preview custom registries by status, matching, bypass risk, cloud agent support and scope.

local-remote-servers.title: Local and remote servers
local-remote-servers.description: Local stdio servers are matched by exact command and can run in the local sandbox; remote servers are matched by canonical URL and run outside it.

connectors-and-plugins.title: Is a Copilot connector allowed?
connectors-and-plugins.description: A connector request is blocked by Registry only, by a deny match, or by an allowlist without the connector URL; otherwise it is allowed.

mcp-secret-scoping.title: How a secret reaches an MCP server
mcp-secret-scoping.description: Organization and repository Agents secrets with the COPILOT_MCP_ prefix flow only to MCP servers, are referenced in env or headers, and are masked in session logs.

github-server-access.title: Widen GitHub MCP access only as needed
github-server-access.description: The built-in GitHub MCP server starts with a read-only token for the current repository; wider access uses a fine-grained read-only token or a GitHub App, with toolsets limited.

repository-mcp-config.title: Configure and validate repository MCP
repository-mcp-config.description: Write the configuration with a tools list, save it for validation, add COPILOT_MCP_ secrets, assign an issue, and check the Start MCP Servers step.

personal-and-agent-servers.title: Which cloud session server wins?
personal-and-agent-servers.description: Defaults are processed first, then custom agent profiles, then repository settings, with later sources overriding earlier ones; a repository server also overrides a same-named personal server.

server-onboarding-review.title: Onboard an MCP server
server-onboarding-review.description: Review the server, allowlist it, validate settings, provision scoped secrets, configure explicit tools, confirm in a session log, then monitor and recheck.

monitoring-offboarding.title: Offboard an MCP server
monitoring-offboarding.description: Deny the server first, remove its configuration, delete and revoke secrets, wait for settings to refresh, confirm in a session, and update the inventory.
